# third_party

Fetched by `CMakeLists.txt` at configure time, pinned to a tag. Only permissive licences
(MIT, BSD, zlib); LGPL only as a separately linked library; never GPL.

| Library | Version | Licence | Used for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SDL3 | release-3.4.18 | zlib | window, input |
| Dear ImGui | v1.93.0-docking | MIT | debug UI, editor v1 |
| Vulkan-Headers | vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 | Apache-2.0 | Vulkan API headers |
| volk | vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 | MIT | Vulkan function loader |
